# Security reporting

Passman is experimental. Use synthetic secrets until its live acceptance and independent review gates are complete. Read [the security profile and reporting policy](../docs/security.md).

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/07rjain/passman/security/advisories/new). Do not put credentials, private keys or sensitive exploit details in public issues. If private reporting is unavailable, request an alternative private route without publishing the details.
